## Environment

State the `perishables --version` output, operating system, and `rustc --version`.

## Minimal reproduction

Provide the smallest OKF bundle or semantic definition file and the exact CLI invocation (including `--as-of` or `--changed-at`) that reproduces the issue.

## Expected versus actual output

State the expected finding set and exit code alongside the actual output observed.
